shared_elements: elaborate headdress-like element above the head
justification: Both are stone works showing an anthropomorphic figure with a broad horizontal belt-like band across the torso and rounded disc motifs, and both place an elaborated headdress/cap element at the top of the body — the most specific correspondence. However, A is a flat rectangular panel of finely cut, densely detailed low relief framed by ordered columns of small square sign-blocks, while B is a massive freestanding three-dimensional sculpture with coarse, weathered, sparse shallow carving and no comparable ordered field of signs, so arrangement and handling differ almost entirely.
